vsm1.1:17.4: 7. "Consciousness-concomitants" (cetasikā) is a collective term for feeling, perception, and formation, variously subdivided; in other words, aspects of mentality that arise together with consciousness.
vsm1.1:19.4: 8. Sīlana and upadhāraṇa in this meaning (cf. Ch. I, §141 and sandhāraṇa, XIV.61) are not in PED.
